reason: A Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness that creates a desktop executable, starts or reconnects to the local web service, and opens it in Chromium app mode.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 创建 Windows 桌面启动器，按需启动本地 Web 服务并以无浏览器工具栏的应用模式打开界面。
summaries.en: Creates a Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness that starts or reconnects to the local web service and opens it in Chromium app mode.

capabilities: Creates a Windows desktop launcher executable and configuration files
Starts or reconnects to the local DeepSeek Harness web service
Launches Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome in app mode
Reuses an existing healthy local service and reports port conflicts
